facts.text: I want a diet plan for a North Indian vegetarian.
I want the diet plan to be like the Mediterranean diet but using Indian foods, spices, and recipes.
I want the plan to take out fish.
I want the plan to include South Indian foods like sambar dosa and uthappam.
I want the plan to include paneer.
I want the plan modified for people who are 60+ years old.
I want the plan modified to lower cholesterol for people who are 60+ years old.
I want the plan to not have any meat or fish.
I want the plan to allow dairy.

keyphrases: vegetarian no meat no fish with dairy
